newsitem.title: ITALY: Sicilian fisherman's wife asks Libya for boat back.
newsitem.headline: Sicilian fisherman's wife asks Libya for boat back.

text.p: The wife of a Sicilian fisherman recently freed by Libya after being convicted for violating its waters asked Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi on Tuesday for a Christmas present -- her husband's boat.
"The 'San Gennaro' is just a little fishing boat, but its our family's only source of income," Irene Grillo said.
She said her husband was due to arrive home via Malta on Tuesday after he and a fellow fisherman spent four months in jail in Libya where they had been convicted of violation of territorial waters.

Italy said on Friday that Libya had decided to free the two men following a meeting between Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini and Libyan foreign liaison minister Omar Mustafa al-Montasser in Rome on Wednesday.
"To complete this humane gesture, I ask only that the boat is set free as well," Grillo told reporters.
Diplomatic sources said that Dini had told Montasser that bilateral relations could not improve if the case of the two men was not resolved.
Italy and the two men had denied that they infringed on the North African country's waters.
